global_invariants: Objective truth, GM solution or conclusion, clue, observation, claim, evidence, hypothesis and Player knowledge remain separately typed through every workflow.

Authorization and permission filtering occur before protected truth, clues, links, sources, counts, search, exports, realtime payloads, diagnostics, notifications, AI context or any derived aggregate is resolved.
Confidence, relevance, authenticity and source reliability remain attributable assessments and never become objective truth probability by implication.
Contradiction, false-lead and solvability diagnostics are review material only and never automatically adjudicate truth, resolve a case or mutate reveal state.
Important-information redundancy uses the source-grounded at-least-two-places guidance as an authoring warning without imposing a universal clue count or success guarantee.
Evidence retains ownerDomain/objectId/objectVersion ownership; PPIA-09 stores Investigation-local references and state only.
PPIA-12 retains World/Setting chronology authority; Player-visible case chronology is a separate permission-safe knowledge projection.
Investigation/Research/Knowledge/Perception/Insight/Forensics mechanics remain owning rules-domain behavior; PPIA-09 does not invent universal DC, XP, time or success formulas.
Spatial clue-board layout remains presentation state; typed semantic relationships and ordered nonvisual equivalents are authoritative.

Every authoritative mutation reauthorizes, revalidates current versions, requires expected_version plus stable operation_id, and uses operation-status/current-version lookup before retry after ambiguous outcomes.
AI-generated organization, theory, connection, clue or mystery material remains proposal-only until explicitly accepted through the governed acceptance action.
No workflow activates application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, release, deployment, testers, paid services or production credentials.

workflows.name: Investigation setup and GM truth framing
preconditions: filter protected truth before derivative projection
steps: author GM solution/conclusion basis separately from Player hypotheses
workflows.mutation_owner: PPIA-09 Investigation and GM truth authority
privacy_requirements: truth/solution filtered before query, counts, search, diagnostics, export or AI context
forbidden_mutations: Player hypothesis cannot implicitly become truth
Investigation setup cannot rewrite Campaign/Scene lifecycle

workflows.name: Clue definition and Campaign clue instantiation
steps: instantiate Campaign Clue from exact source snapshot
workflows.mutation_owner: PPIA-09 clue-definition adapter and Campaign-local clue state
privacy_requirements: protected clue existence and reveal metadata filtered before browse/counts/autocomplete
forbidden_mutations: clue instantiation cannot transfer source-domain ownership
default reveal policy does not itself reveal

workflows.name: Discovery and analysis play loop
workflows.mutation_owner: PPIA-09 discovery adapter plus owning resolution workflow
privacy_requirements: resolution success never bypasses reveal permission
recovery_requirements: discovery/analysis writes use expected_version plus operation_id
forbidden_mutations: no universal DC/XP/time/success formula invented
research success cannot auto-create truth

workflows.name: Observation, claim and evidence capture
preconditions: authorize case authoring and referenced objects
keep observation, claim and truth separate
workflows.mutation_owner: PPIA-09 statement/evidence-reference adapters plus owning domains
privacy_requirements: protected objects/witnesses/claims filtered before relationship expansion or counts
forbidden_mutations: evidence attachment cannot mutate source ownership
claim/observation cannot silently become truth

workflows.name: Evidence and source-quality annotation review
steps: review without converting assessment to truth probability
privacy_requirements: basisRefs filtered before explanation or aggregation
recovery_requirements: annotation writes require expected_version plus operation_id
forbidden_mutations: no mandatory universal numeric probability scale
annotations cannot rewrite truth

workflows.name: Hypothesis, theory and semantic-connection building
preconditions: authorize visible nodes before relationship authoring
treat graph layout as presentation only
workflows.mutation_owner: PPIA-09 / MV-IA-F011 hypothesis and typed-connection state
privacy_requirements: hidden nodes cannot leak through edges, graph spacing, counts or autocomplete
recovery_requirements: hypothesis/connection writes use expected_version plus operation_id
forbidden_mutations: graph position is not semantic truth
Player hypothesis never auto-promotes to fact

workflows.name: Question, lead and research tracking
preconditions: keep research request distinct from resolution mechanics
steps: attach permitted sources and research requests
privacy_requirements: hidden clues/sources cannot appear in lead autocomplete
forbidden_mutations: no universal research formula invented
lead completion does not create truth

workflows.name: Timeline and alibi authoring and comparison
privacy_requirements: hidden Setting chronology filtered before Player case chronology
recovery_requirements: timeline/alibi writes require expected_version plus operation_id
forbidden_mutations: cannot rewrite PPIA-12 chronology
temporal tension does not adjudicate truth

workflows.name: Contradiction, false-lead and corrupted-evidence review
steps: mark false-lead/corruption metadata with recovery refs
recovery_requirements: review writes idempotent and retain historical inputs
forbidden_mutations: contradiction never chooses truth
false lead cannot rewrite truth
no universal false-lead fairness threshold

workflows.name: Revelation dependency authoring and solvability audit
preconditions: resolve required/optional/bonus revelation records and routes
exclude unauthorized routes from caller-visible diagnostics
steps: apply source-grounded at-least-two-places warning to important information
privacy_requirements: permission filtering before dependency graph, route counts and warnings
recovery_requirements: dependency writes use expected_version plus operation_id
forbidden_mutations: diagnostic never resolves case, invents route, mutates truth/reveal
at least two places is warning not universal clue-count law or guarantee

workflows.name: Stall recovery and dynamic extra-clue delivery
privacy_requirements: recovery diagnostics cannot disclose hidden recovery paths
forbidden_mutations: diagnostic cannot fabricate clue automatically
dynamic clue cannot lose attribution or alter truth

workflows.name: Reveal, withhold and revoke control
privacy_requirements: preview and post-change projection both filter before resolution
recovery_requirements: reveal transitions require expected_version plus operation_id
forbidden_mutations: preview cannot mutate reveal state
visibility never implies truth

workflows.name: Player investigation board and knowledge-safe review
steps: navigate same semantics without graph position
forbidden_mutations: read-only review cannot mutate truth/reveal/source objects
graph layout not sole meaning

workflows.name: GM reference mystery and dossier workbench
preconditions: separate source-backed material from governed design
steps: review The Vanishing of Dr. Wen and fixtures without inventing unsupported source detail
privacy_requirements: workbench/export/AI context use same authorization filter
recovery_requirements: case revision uses expected_version plus operation_id
forbidden_mutations: fixture review cannot fabricate source canon
diagnostics cannot rewrite authored mystery

workflows.name: Investigation conclusion, resolution and retained history
steps: author explicit conclusion with basis refs
privacy_requirements: conclusion/basis projection obeys knowledge permissions separately from truth authority
recovery_requirements: conclusion write requires expected_version plus operation_id
forbidden_mutations: resolution cannot retroactively make every hypothesis fact
cannot mutate source objects

workflows.name: AI-assisted investigation proposal review and acceptance
preconditions: filter hidden information before AI context
steps: accept only explicit acceptedDiff through governed action
outputs: proposal-only artifact or accepted governed state
forbidden_mutations: AI proposal never authoritative without explicit acceptance
AI cannot bypass permissions/truth/reveal/ownership

workflows.name: History, recovery, reconnect and accessible linear operation
entry_points: History / Provenance / Recovery & Accessible Linear View
forbidden_mutations: read-only recovery cannot blind-retry writes
offline cannot silently commit authoritative state

workflows.name: Cross-domain evidence, chronology and permission audit
preconditions: separate Investigation-local state from source ownership
steps: verify ownership, permission-before-derivatives and nonvisual parity
privacy_requirements: each domain filtered before cross-domain aggregation
recovery_requirements: audit pins source versions and reports stale/unavailable refs without copying
forbidden_mutations: audit cannot mutate source objects or PPIA-12 chronology
correlation cannot become truth
